meta_note: All routes are prefixed with /api/recurring and protected by ApiGuard (JWT bearer). Each request is forwarded to the Finance microservice via gRPC. Aggregate responses are Redis-cached (5 min, USER_CACHE_TTL) and invalidated on any mutation.

conventions.route_order: GET /aggregate is declared before GET /:id to prevent the :id wildcard from capturing 'aggregate' as an ID.
conventions.cache: GET /aggregate is Redis-cached per user (KEY: recurring_aggregate:{userId}, TTL: 300 s). All mutation routes (POST, PATCH, DELETE) call invalidateAggregateCache() fire-and-forget after a successful gRPC response.

createRecurring.description: Creates a new recurring income or expense item. nextRunAt is computed by the Finance service. The scheduler picks up active items and creates transactions on each run date.

request_body.name: string (required, max 255)
request_body.endDate: string (optional) — ISO date; omit for indefinite

errors.400: Validation error — missing required field or invalid value
errors.401: Access token missing, invalid, or expired

getRecurrings.description: Returns all recurring items for the authenticated user with optional server-side filtering and sorting. Active items always appear before paused items regardless of sortBy.

query_params.isActive: boolean (optional) — true: active only; false: paused only; omit: all
query_params.frequency: string[] (optional, repeated) — one or more frequency values

errors.401: Access token missing, invalid, or expired

getRecurringsAggregate.description: Returns pre-computed aggregate stats for the bills page widgets (active count, paused count, monthly expense total, monthly income total). Response is Redis-cached per user for 5 minutes and invalidated on any mutation. Backed by a single Prisma groupBy query in the Finance service — no row-level computation.

data.monthlyExpense: number — total expense amount normalised to monthly
data.monthlyIncome: number — total income amount normalised to monthly

errors.401: Access token missing, invalid, or expired

getRecurring.description: Returns a single recurring item by ID, including its full transaction history (transactions ordered newest-first).

errors.401: Access token missing, invalid, or expired
errors.404: Recurring item not found or does not belong to the user

updateRecurring.description: Updates an existing recurring item. All body fields are optional; only provided fields are patched. If frequency changes, nextRunAt is recomputed from today by the Finance service.

request_body.name: string (optional, max 255)
request_body.endDate: string (optional) — ISO date; send null/empty to clear

errors.401: Access token missing, invalid, or expired

toggleRecurring.description: Toggles the isActive flag on a recurring item. Deactivating stops the scheduler from creating new transactions. Reactivating recomputes nextRunAt from today so the schedule resumes without gaps.

errors.401: Access token missing, invalid, or expired

deleteRecurring.description: Permanently deletes a recurring item. Transactions that were already created by the scheduler are NOT deleted.

errors.401: Access token missing, invalid, or expired

export_cache_invalidation.description: Successful recurring mutations invalidate all Redis keys export:{userId}:* (fire-and-forget) so analytics exports regenerate on the next request.
